signal: Selerix acquired TBX to build an all-in-one benefits administration SaaS platform

email.body1:
Zephyr, saw Selerix folded in TBX to build out the all-in-one benefits administration platform.

An acquisition that broadens the platform usually opens more broker and employer accounts than the sales team can work before the cross-sell window closes, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Selerix off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zephyr, quick follow-up for Selerix.

A bigger platform usually raises the pipeline target faster than headcount can follow. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Selerix needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zephyr, last bit of proof for Selerix.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Selerix's reply rate likely compares to other benefits and HR tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zephyr, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after an acquisition, and I know integrating two platforms is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a benefits-admin motion? I will tailor it to Selerix either way.
